This excessive multiple is completely unprotected by any income return for shareholders, as the stock offers a dividend yield of a flat 0.00% [E4]. Furthermore, the business has hit a severe operational wall, demonstrated by a catastrophic compounded profit growth rate of -60% over the trailing twelve months [E21]. This sharp earnings contraction validates the warning that price growth has exceeded profit growth by 44%, proving that market expectations are dangerously running ahead of actual delivery [E55]. Conceded: the company demonstrates strong multi-year profit acceleration with compounded growth of 23% over 5 years and 74% over 3 years [E19, E20], alongside robust top-line expansion of 28% year-over-year [E64]. However, paying a massive premium for a company whose recent earnings have collapsed by 60% [E21] exposes investors to significant downside risk when momentum reverses.

Conceded: trailing twelve months compounded profit growth is -60% [E21] and the trailing P/E stands at an elevated 62.2x [E1] or 77.18x against the sector benchmark of 19.86x [E6], alongside a 0.00% dividend yield [E4]. However, the bear's focus on a single period ignores explosive multi-year operational acceleration, including a compounded profit growth rate of 74% over 3 years and 23% over 5 years [E19, E20]. This exceptional historical compounding is further powered by robust top-line momentum, driven by year-over-year sales growth of 28% [E64] and confirmed by rising sales both year-over-year and quarter-over-quarter [E64, E67]. Furthermore, the company's operational efficiency outperforms sector benchmarks, delivering a Return on Assets (ROA) of 1.87% compared to the sector median of 1.55% [E8]. Therefore, the current valuation reflects forward-looking growth capacity rather than a static earnings snapshot, underscored by steady long-term compounding of 12% over a 10-year horizon [E18].

Conceded: compounded profit growth stands at 74% over 3 years and 23% over 5 years [E19, E20], alongside an ROA of 1.87% that beats the sector benchmark of 1.55% [E8]. However, citing multi-year acceleration completely obscures the severe and immediate collapse occurring right now, evidenced by a trailing twelve-month profit growth rate of -60% [E21]. This sharp recent contraction directly undermines the bull's claim of forward-looking growth capacity, especially when paired with an extreme trailing P/E of 77.18x that dwarfs the sector benchmark of 19.86x [E6]. Furthermore, price growth recently exceeds profit growth by 44% [E55], proving that market expectations are wildly detached from underlying financial delivery. Finally, relying on top-line sales growth of 28% [E64] provides zero comfort to investors when bottom-line earnings are evaporating by 60% [E21] and the company pays a 0.00% dividend yield [E4].
